comments.text: Operation Cactus, 1988 is one of India's finest rapid military interventions. When mercenaries tried to overthrow the Maldivian government, India airlifted troops within hours and crushed the coup, restoring President Gayoom to power. Ironic, considering how strained India Maldives relations often are today yet India has consistently stood by them in moments of real crisis
